findings.corrective_action: Atomically transition OPEN to EXIT_CLAIMED before external calls, create a unique durable attempt, serialize nonce allocation per chain and wallet, and reconcile before permitting another exit.
findings.deterministic_evidence: No pre-broadcast state transition exists in close_position; state is changed only after the external transaction path.

evidence.detail: close_position reads an OPEN position, broadcasts and waits for the SELL, and only afterward acquires _DB_LOCK to mark the position closed; no durable pre-broadcast compare-and-set claim exists.
An independent intelligence worker invokes close_position while SiBot monitoring and leader-event paths can invoke the same operation.
_base_tx independently obtains the pending nonce without a wallet-scoped nonce reservation.

findings.impact: Two workers can sell the same OPEN position or submit transactions with colliding nonces, causing replacement, failure, unintended ordering, or excess disposal.
findings.root_cause: The lock protects the final accounting update rather than the claim-build-broadcast-reconcile lifecycle.
tests_required: Race two close_position callers and assert exactly one broadcast.
Crash after broadcast and verify restart reconciliation.
Verify concurrent same-wallet operations receive unique monotonic nonces.
findings.title: Concurrent EVM exits can broadcast more than one sell

findings.corrective_action: Persist BROADCAST or RECONCILING and the transaction hash immediately after submission; resolve asynchronously and prohibit retries while the outcome is unknown.
findings.deterministic_evidence: The exception record explicitly discards the hash even when submission completed before receipt polling failed.

evidence.detail: A transaction hash is returned before wait_for_transaction_receipt, but a receipt timeout reaches the broad exception handler, which records REJECTED with an empty tx_hash.
close_position broadcasts and synchronously waits; timeout leaves the position OPEN without durably retaining the submitted hash or an unresolved state.

findings.impact: A transaction may later confirm on-chain while local state says rejected or open, allowing duplicate execution and corrupting exposure, fees, P&L, and notifications.
findings.root_cause: Broadcast and confirmation are treated as one operation, with no durable intermediate lifecycle.
tests_required: Simulate successful send followed by receipt timeout and assert the hash is retained.
Reconcile successful, reverted, replaced, and dropped transactions after restart.
Assert unresolved attempts block resubmission.
findings.title: Ambiguous broadcasts lose their transaction hash and can be retried

findings.corrective_action: Store authorization state transactionally in SQLite using BEGIN IMMEDIATE and conditional updates, or use process-wide and OS-level locking with an in-lock re-read.
findings.deterministic_evidence: user_registry.py contains no lock covering activation-code validation and persistence.

evidence.detail: redeem_activation_code reads CSV state, checks and increments uses, then replaces the file without a thread/process lock or conditional transaction.
User creation, updates, and per-user trading-setting writes use the same unlocked read-modify-replace pattern.
Telegram functionality uses multiple callbacks and worker threads, making concurrent mutations feasible.

findings.impact: Concurrent callers can both redeem a single-use code or silently overwrite authorization and trading settings.
findings.root_cause: Atomic file replacement guarantees file visibility, not atomicity of the preceding read, validation, and mutation.
tests_required: Race two redemptions of a one-use code and assert exactly one succeeds.
Test concurrent user creation and setting changes for lost updates.
Include a multi-process locking test.
findings.title: Activation-code limits and user settings use unlocked read-modify-write operations

findings.corrective_action: Derive token/native changes from transaction receipt logs and chain-specific metadata, retaining snapshots only as reconciliation checks.
findings.deterministic_evidence: Both execution paths compute economic results from balances sampled at different times.

evidence.detail: Solana wallet_delta_lamports is calculated from time-separated pre/post RPC wallet balances around order, simulation, and execution.
EVM realised value is derived from before/after wrapped-token balances rather than transaction-specific receipt deltas.

findings.impact: Concurrent trades, transfers, rent changes, or other wallet activity can be misattributed to one trade, corrupting realised P&L, performance controls, and profit-share calculations.
findings.root_cause: Accounting uses wallet-level snapshots rather than transaction-scoped on-chain evidence.
tests_required: Parse EVM receipt logs and Solana transaction metadata into transaction-scoped deltas.
Inject unrelated balance movement between snapshots and prove it is excluded.
Cover fees, rent, wrapped-native movements, partial fills, and account closure.
findings.title: Trade P&L attributes unrelated wallet balance changes to executions

findings.corrective_action: Separate accrued and paid fees, persist transaction identity and nonce, confirm settlement, and implement idempotent retry/reconciliation.
findings.deterministic_evidence: No code path reconciles BROADCAST/PENDING fee-ledger rows to a confirmed on-chain outcome.

evidence.detail: Fee transfer submission immediately reduces user net and increases cumulative profit fee while the fee ledger records BROADCAST or PENDING.
A fee transfer is treated as successful when send_raw_transaction returns; its receipt is not confirmed.
The ledger appends fee states but provides no durable settlement worker that resolves pending, reverted, replaced, or dropped transfers.

findings.impact: Reported user net, master revenue, and outstanding liabilities can diverge from on-chain balances indefinitely.
findings.root_cause: Fee accrual and confirmed payment are represented as the same accounting event.
tests_required: Cover confirmed, reverted, dropped, replaced, timed-out, and pre-send failures.
Reconcile gross P&L, user net, accrued fees, and paid fees independently.
Verify restart recovery cannot double-charge.
findings.title: Profit-share submissions are accounted as paid without confirmation

findings.corrective_action: Make report evaluation pure, persist only explicit material-change evaluations, and separate get-or-create lookup from new-version registration.
findings.deterministic_evidence: The report call deterministically reaches UPDATE and INSERT statements for registered strategies.

evidence.detail: The master report calls portfolio_report while presenting the command as read-only.
portfolio_report evaluates every strategy; evaluation updates registry status and inserts a decision row on each call.
A cache-cold lookup can call register_strategy, increment the version, and reset an existing lifecycle status to SHADOW.

findings.impact: Viewing a report changes control state, restarts can erase REWORK/REPLACE status and weaken the sizing throttle, and duplicate decisions grow SQLite storage.
findings.root_cause: Read queries, evaluation persistence, and idempotent lookup are conflated.
tests_required: Assert repeated report rendering performs no writes.
Assert cache loss or restart preserves version and status.
Create a new version only when canonical strategy specification changes.
Deduplicate or safely bound decision history.
findings.title: Read-only Strategy Lab reports mutate lifecycle state and grow decision history

findings.corrective_action: Use an event-driven minimal preflight, gate disabled/unchanged work before checkout and installation, use shallow/API retrieval, and pin/cache provider tools.
findings.deterministic_evidence: Workflow step ordering places expensive setup ahead of both lane and unchanged-content gates.

evidence.detail: The five-minute, two-lane matrix performs full-history checkout and installs requirements plus four @latest provider CLIs before checking lane controls and unchanged-report signatures.

Deterministic inventory reports 36 scheduled workflows, 11 scheduled self-hosted workflows, 22 full-history checkouts, 46 git fetches, 38 latest CLI installs, 23 npm installs, 58 pip installs, and 47 paid-AI workflows.
Host-wide sampled network rate is 180.566 MB/hour; telemetry explicitly does not attribute this solely to the bot.

findings.impact: Disabled or unchanged lanes repeatedly consume API/model budget, bandwidth, runner time, package caches, and workspace disk.
findings.root_cause: Cheap control and material-change checks occur after checkout and dependency/tool installation.
tests_required: Prove unchanged reports skip provider calls, checkout, and package installation.
Prove disabled lanes create no matrix worker.
Measure per-run downloads, provider calls, cache growth, and retained worktrees.
Verify optimisation preserves all trading safety controls.
findings.title: Scheduled AI adjudication performs expensive setup before material-change gates

findings.corrective_action: Measure all major paths and growth rates, then apply bounded, recoverable retention to disposable workspaces, caches, logs, and artifacts; never automatically remove wallets, databases, or audit evidence.
findings.deterministic_evidence: The sanitised snapshot directly measures only 573820928 free bytes and labels disk status CRITICAL.

evidence.detail: Root filesystem is 92.08% used with 573820928 bytes free; disk status is CRITICAL and the runner workspace consumes 319075967 bytes.

The size-only attribution snapshot identifies actions-runner and /usr/local usage but reports several production, cache, log, and temporary locations as null, leaving the dominant growth source unresolved.

findings.impact: Package installation, checkout, SQLite WAL growth, backups, or deployment can exhaust the filesystem, causing database write failures, partial deployments, missing audit records, and service interruption.
findings.root_cause: Numerous scheduled self-hosted jobs generate workspaces and caches while retention and complete disk-growth attribution are insufficient.
tests_required: Alert and fail safely before SQLite or deployment space is exhausted.
Measure workspace/cache/log growth across scheduled workflow cycles.
Verify cleanup allowlists exclude wallet material, databases, and audit evidence.
Confirm interrupted writes and deployments recover safely under ENOSPC.
findings.title: Root filesystem has critically low free space without complete growth attribution
